districtFact: St. Vrain Valley Schools uses staggered opening dates by grade and seven Professional Learning Community days when students begin 2.5 hours later than usual. The official academic calendar lists 174 student contact days.

about.title: About the St. Vrain Academic Calendar
about.content: SVVSD does not use one first day for every student. Grades 1–5, 6, and 9 begin first; grades 7–8 and 10–12 follow the next day; kindergarten and preschool begin later.

about.title: PLC Late Starts and Contact Days
about.content: The academic calendar lists seven Professional Learning Community late-start days. Students attend school on those dates but begin 2.5 hours later than usual.

planningTips.title: SVVSD Calendar Notes
content: Check the grade-level opening schedule before adding a first day to your calendar.
PLC dates are attendance days, but classes begin 2.5 hours later than usual.
Use your child’s school calendar for conferences, bell times, testing, graduation details, and emergency changes.

districtFaqs.q: Does every St. Vrain student start school on the same day?
districtFaqs.a: No. SVVSD staggers the opening by grade: grades 1-5, 6, and 9 begin first, followed by grades 7-8 and 10-12, then kindergarten and preschool.

districtFaqs.q: What is an SVVSD PLC late-start day?
districtFaqs.a: It is a student attendance day when all schools begin 2.5 hours later than normal while teachers and staff participate in collaborative professional development.

districtFaqs.q: How many student contact days are on the St. Vrain calendar?
districtFaqs.a: SVVSD’s 2025–26, 2026–27, and 2027–28 academic calendars each list 174 student contact days.

districtFaqs.q: Are St. Vrain calendars available in Spanish?
districtFaqs.a: The district also publishes Spanish versions of its academic calendars.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify school-specific dates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official SVVSD school-calendar page and your child’s school calendar for conferences, bell times, graduation details, testing, and emergency changes.
